releaseNotes: Location-based destination alarms with warning distance and arrival radius.
Foreground-service monitoring with adaptive location frequency.
OpenStreetMap-compatible map (MapLibre) behind a swappable provider interface.
Local-first: alarms, places and history stay on the device.
knownLimitations: Debug APKs are not production-signed releases.
Background execution can be restricted by some device manufacturers; see docs/testing.md and the README.
